project: Wuxia Life P107 Merchant Martial Patron Payoff Design-First
description: Design-first contract stage for merchant_martial_patron payoff phase — define payoff direction (choice-based vs auto deepening), choice options, contract, and validation shape before P108 implementation, preserving merchant-martial patron flavor.

userStories.title: Audit patron payoff prerequisites
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a prerequisite audit for the patron payoff stage so P107 starts from the real gating surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize existing patron route flags, markers, events, and expressions (P102 bridge + P103/P104 bridge-origin + P106 pressure)
Document current merchant_patron_payoff_echo gate after P106 pressure gate adjustment
Record merchant_patron_payoff_resolved and merchant_patron_late_life_done placeholder status
Save docs/test-reports/p107-merchant-martial-patron-payoff-prerequisite-audit.md
Do not change runtime behavior in this story
userStories.notes: Prerequisite audit saved; zero runtime changes.

userStories.title: Lock P107 scope contract
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a scope contract so P107 stays design-first and does not slip into partial implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Limit P107 to gap audit, direction comparison, payoff contract, and proof shape only
Define allowed layers: documentation, contract, targeted proof planning
List forbidden expansions: runtime wiring, P106 rewrite, magnate spine rewrite, late-life design, new UI
Save docs/test-reports/p107-merchant-martial-patron-payoff-scope-contract.md

userStories.title: Compare patron payoff directions (choice-based vs auto)
userStories.description: As a designer, I want payoff-direction options so P107 chooses the most differentiated and bounded payoff shape before implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Compare at least 2 payoff modes: choice-based (how to resolve merchant-martial tension?) vs auto deepening (P102 echo pattern)
If choice-based selected, compare at least 3 choice directions with distinct narrative and mechanical identity
Each candidate includes: core narrative, trigger conditions, player choice space, patron flavor fit, distinction from magnate/renown payoff, implementation complexity
Select recommended direction and document rejected alternatives
Save docs/test-reports/p107-merchant-martial-patron-payoff-direction-comparison.md

userStories.title: Define patron payoff contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want an explicit payoff contract so P108 knows exactly what flags, gates, events, and player-facing meanings must be closed.
acceptanceCriteria: Define payoff checkpoint, required flags, and gate acceptance including merchant_patron_midlife_pressure_done upstream
Define 1 core payoff event (choice-based or auto)
If choice-based, define stat changes, identity markers, and expression differences per choice
Define at least 3 payoff-specific player-facing signals
Clarify difference between payoff vs pressure and vs P102 lightweight echo
Preserve merchant-martial patron flavor; distinguish from magnate auto and renown choice payoff
Reserve flag interfaces for subsequent late-life / endgame stages
Save contract to docs/PRD/p107-merchant-martial-patron-payoff-contract.md

userStories.title: Define P108 validation shape
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the P108 validation shape fixed in advance so playable payoff work is judged against explicit expectations.
acceptanceCriteria: Define which chain nodes targeted proof must show (pressure to payoff to expression changes)
If choice-based, each choice direction must have core node verification
Define which assertions regression tests must cover at minimum
Define what evidence counts as payoff closed
No full lifetime exhaust required
Define regression boundaries for P102-P106 and P100/P101 magnate existing evidence
Save docs/test-reports/p107-p108-validation-shape.md

userStories.title: Produce P107 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report that locks the patron payoff design-first contract and hands off to P108.
acceptanceCriteria: Save docs/test-reports/p107-merchant-martial-patron-payoff-closure-report.md
Summarize prerequisite audit, scope contract, direction comparison, payoff contract, validation shape
Clarify boundary with P108
List remaining deferred larger patron-expansion items
State GO or NO-GO for payoff implementation stage
